description: Small Ralph self-iteration for branch ralph/self-iteration-20260520-002052. The previous active PRD had all stories passing and was archived under scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260520-115019/. Fresh GitHub health at 2026-05-20 11:50 CST: latest main CI run 26109104836 completed success and latest branch pull_request CI run 26139790386 completed success. A newer LLM review auto-fix context requested changes because Vertex scenario-run SDKs and web helpers still modeled POST /api/vertex/v1/scenarios/{scenarioRid}/runs as SSE or terminal output, while the mounted handler and OpenAPI contract return 202 JSON {runRid,status} and require GET /runs/{runRid} polling. userStories.name: Align Vertex clients with start-and-poll scenario runs
userStories.description: Update the TypeScript, Python, and Go Vertex SDKs plus the web scenario-run helper/docs so public clients match the mounted scenario-run contract: POST /runs starts a run and returns {runRid,status}; GET /runs/{runRid} is the polling source for terminal records. Remove or guard public streaming helpers until a mounted stream endpoint exists.
bdd_acceptance: Given the server accepts POST /api/vertex/v1/scenarios/{scenarioRid}/runs with 202 {runRid,status}, When TypeScript VertexClient.scenarios.run is called without streaming, Then it starts the run and polls GET /runs/{runRid} until a terminal record is returned.
Given the same mounted start response, When Python client.vertex.scenarios.run is called, Then it starts the run and waits via GET /runs/{runRid}; no default path opens SSE against POST /runs.

Given the same mounted start response, When Go Client.Vertex.Scenarios.Run is called, Then it returns the terminal ScenarioRunRecord by starting and polling; no Accept: text/event-stream request is sent to POST /runs.

Given no /runs/{runRid}/stream route is mounted or documented, When web scenario-run route helpers are built, Then they expose start, get, and cancel routes only and tests no longer describe a stream route as documented.
Given the cookbook examples are followed, When they run a Vertex scenario, Then they demonstrate start-and-poll usage instead of mocked SSE from POST /runs.
quality_gates: `npm test -- SdkVertexClient.test.ts scenarioRunAsync.test.ts scenarioRunRouteContract.bdd.test.ts` from web/
`npm test -- scenarioRunStream.test.ts` from web/ if stream-client compatibility changes are needed
